newsitem.title: USA: Teleport to postpone debt, equity offering.
newsitem.headline: Teleport to postpone debt, equity offering.

text.p: Teleport Communications Group Inc said Friday that after evaluating current market conditions, it has decided to postpone considering an equity and debt offering.
The company said it had been contemplating an equity offering of about $200 million and about $350 million in debt financing for its 1998 capital requirements.

Teleport said it will continue to assess market conditions to determine the most effective time, and financing vehicle, to increase the company's financial flexibility. It said its current cash position provides for its business plan in 1998.

Separately, the company said that Continental Cablevision US WEST Media Group has reduced its ownerships stake in it to below 10 percent, fulfilling the Department of Justice's June 30, 1997 divestiture requirement.
